head: warmread is a teleprompter that follows your voice
dek: warmread scrolls your script as you talk, waits when you pause and keeps your place when you ad-lib; the next lines glow so your eyes stay ahead. It was #60 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 7 November.
details: No remote needed. It came out on 6 November and costs $4.99 with in-app purchases, by Roger Sengthavychith.
means: If you film videos or give talks, you can read from your phone without a helper scrolling.
todo: Find warmread in the App Store.
